scope: Layer B only (spec section 8.4.1 rule 1: field presence and default-value handling). Layer A (RFC 8785 canonicalization + a2a signatures-exclusion) lives in a2a-jcs-v01. Rule 1 is under-determined as written on one point - what to do when a REQUIRED field is absent from the input - so these vectors are organised as one expectation per candidate resolution rather than as a single answer.

resolutions.presence-preserving: Fields the input carries are kept (REQUIRED always; optional when explicitly set, even at the default value), a non-REQUIRED empty repeated field is dropped by rule 1, and absent REQUIRED fields are NOT materialised.
resolutions.inject-required-defaults: The REQUIRED set is materialised before canonicalization unconditionally, so absent REQUIRED fields appear at their type defaults (string values as "", repeated fields as []).
resolutions.strict-presence-validation: An input lacking REQUIRED fields is refused rather than canonicalised.

spec_provenance.required_set: a2aproject/A2A specification/a2a.proto, AgentCard: name, description, supported_interfaces, version, capabilities, default_input_modes, default_output_modes, skills
spec_provenance.note: The REQUIRED set above is transcribed from the proto annotations, not from prose.

agent-card-canonicalization-input.function: the bytes a card signature covers, after rule 1 presence/default processing and RFC 8785 canonicalization
